# What .github/workflows/kernel-tuning.yml runs (docs/plan-1.6.1.md Part 12). Lines:
#   serial SERIAL                       the release whose layers are used (default: the newest beta)
#   kernel NAME [+OPTION] [-OPTION] [~OPTION] [repro]   a test kernel from this tree: the release's configuration
#                                       (kconfig.sh) with options turned on (+), off (-) or made modules (~); repro: built
#                                       with its date fixed, to compare two
#   base NAME                           a test base layer: the release's with this tree's sys/root and rudolfd
#   run PHASE KERNEL [VAR=VALUE ...]    iso/qt/sb/kt161_t.py PHASE with the release's kernel (release) or a test kernel;
#                                       BASE=NAME: with that base layer; lists in a value are written with commas
serial 2026111620
kernel tree
kernel zstd +KERNEL_ZSTD -KERNEL_XZ +INITRAMFS_COMPRESSION_ZSTD -INITRAMFS_COMPRESSION_XZ
kernel netmod ~E1000 ~E1000E ~IGB ~IGC ~R8169 ~ATL1C ~ALX ~TIGON3 ~8139CP ~8139TOO ~NE2K_PCI ~PCNET32 ~WIREGUARD
base new
run startup release STARTS=5
run startup release BASE=new STARTS=5
run startup tree BASE=new STARTS=5
run startup zstd BASE=new STARTS=5
run startup netmod BASE=new STARTS=5
run startup release ENGINE=native STARTS=4
run startup release BASE=new ENGINE=native STARTS=4
run power release BASE=new
